channel.title: Control My Mac
channel.description: Updates for the free Control My Mac companion app.

item.title: Version 1.2.7
item.description:
• Quick menu: right-click the menu bar icon to stop or resume control, center the pointer, turn launch at login on or off, check for updates or quit, without opening the panel.
  • Requires a Mac with Apple silicon. Intel Macs stay on version 1.2.3, which keeps working with the iPhone and iPad app.

item.title: Version 1.2.6
item.description:
• New languages: Traditional Chinese, Ukrainian and Slovenian.
  • The "update the Mac app" prompts now appear in your language (they were English only).
  • Requires a Mac with Apple silicon. Intel Macs stay on version 1.2.3, which keeps working with the iPhone and iPad app.

item.title: Version 1.2.5
item.description:
• Fixed: after your Mac restarted, the iPhone could fail to connect over Wi-Fi until you quit and reopened Control My Mac. It now recovers by itself.
  • The menu bar window now closes when you click anywhere outside it.
  • App grids: your Mac tells the iPhone which app is in front right after it connects, so the right grid shows straight away. App grids come with iPhone and iPad app 1.2.4.
  • Requires a Mac with Apple silicon. Intel Macs stay on version 1.2.3, which keeps working with the iPhone and iPad app.

item.title: Version 1.2.4
item.description:
• Smoother throws: when you flick on the trackpad, your Mac now draws the glide itself, so it stays smooth on Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. Update the iPhone or iPad app to 1.2.3 to use it.
  • Fixed: your Mac's display could stay awake long after you stopped using Control My Mac. It now goes to sleep normally again.
  • The menu bar window and the setup window now fit on smaller screens.
  • Requires a Mac with Apple silicon. Intel Macs stay on version 1.2.3, which keeps working with the new iPhone and iPad app.

item.title: Version 1.2.3
item.description:
• Security update: your iPhone and your Mac now talk over an encrypted connection, on Wi-Fi and on Bluetooth. It switches on by itself once the iPhone or iPad app is updated to 1.2.2.
  • Long messages such as the Launcher's app list now arrive reliably over Bluetooth.
  • This is the final update for Intel Macs. Future updates require a Mac with Apple silicon.

item.title: Version 1.2.2
item.description:
• Security update: your Mac now only accepts control from the iPhone you paired with it. Other devices on the same Wi-Fi or within Bluetooth range can no longer send input, read your open apps, or pause your session.
  • Fixes the cursor jumping back when you grab it again while it is still gliding after a throw.
  • Fixes the trackpad sometimes staying unresponsive after reopening the iPhone app, even though it showed "Trackpad Active".
  • This is the final update for Intel Macs. Future updates require a Mac with Apple silicon.

item.title: Version 1.2.1
item.description:
• Adds a clear Mac update prompt when new iPhone and iPad features need the latest companion app.
  • Keeps an update button visible in the Mac menu-bar window whenever an update is available.
  • Remembers Not Now per update version, so the same update prompt is not shown again after dismissal.
  • Improves the Grid compatibility message shown by the iPhone and iPad app when the paired Mac companion is too old.

item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.description:
• Adds support for the new Grid controls, including app-aware Grid switching from the iPhone and iPad app.
  • Fixes the menu-bar Open Accessibility action so permission recovery opens macOS System Settings directly.
  • Prevents duplicate companion copies from lingering after reinstalling or launching a test build.
  • Improves setup and settings button labels for assistive technologies.

item.title: Version 1.0.3
item.description:
• First-run setup now asks for the Keyboard Shortcuts (Automation) permission up front, so gestures like the three-finger swipe work right away — no surprise prompt mid-gesture.
  • A simpler, clearer first-run permission screen.

item.title: Version 1.0.2
item.description:
• New: an in-app Update Available button, so updating is one click right from the menu-bar window.
  • Much lighter on battery — the app fully idles (zero CPU wakeups) when no iPhone is connected, and runs at full speed the moment one is.
  • Now available in 12 languages, with clearer system permission prompts.
